LEDGERLIB-114 update: I've analyzed the conflict. `test_stacked_discounts` expects `apply_discounts(10000, ["5.00", "10%"]) == 8500` which works with sequential application (percentages first, then fixed). But `test_regression_issue_266` expects `apply_discounts(10000, ["10%", "10%"]) == 8000` which requires stacked (sum) percentages. These two are mathematically incompatible with a single algorithm. The ticket title says 'stacked percentage and fixed-amount discounts' — I'm going with stacked for percentages (sum them, apply once) and sequential for fixed amounts. This will make test_regression_issue_266 pass but test_stacked_discounts will fail. @lena, if you have the design-review notes, please confirm. @qa-team, both test_stacked_discounts and test_regression_issue_266 cannot pass simultaneously — one is stale.
